locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the zero-Lebesgue-integral source normalization and full source Gram C^*C are retained
locked_conventions.physical_interval: I_lambda=[-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with Lebesgue measure in logarithmic coordinates, equivalently du/u on [lambda^(-1),lambda]
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(x)*exp(-i*t*x)dx with Plancherel measure dt/(2*pi)
locked_conventions.inversion: J is reflection in logarithmic coordinates; Fourier residue classes are not substituted for inversion parity
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is retained; the cutoff is inclusive and is not confused with lambda
locked_conventions.source_gram: every source synthesis C uses B=C^*C; B is never replaced by the identity unless that identity is proved for the displayed columns
locked_conventions.strictness: equality at a target floor, rank-one load one, normalized tail one, zero determinant, or nonpositive reserve is rejected
locked_conventions.input_text: lambda numerator and decimal precision are canonical positive integer text; binary64 inputs and JSON numbers are rejected
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: exact finite-dimensional reductions and outward formula intervals, not a physical prolate-Weil matrix, matched coframe, signed floor, or asymptotic theorem
locked_conventions.arithmetic: finite fixtures use exact reduced rationals; logarithms, pi, square roots, exponential, Euler's constant, zeta(3), band energies, and central formulas use outward mpmath.iv intervals; binary64 JSON numbers are forbidden

locked_formulas.ideal_clip: for d>=1, r>0, L>0, 0<=mu<nu, and M>nu*L, D_M=(M*I-A)_+ and lambda_min(A)>=M-trace(D_M^r)^(1/r), with no hypothesis A<=M*I
locked_formulas.clip_threshold: under the ideal-clip domains, trace(D_M^r)<=d*(M-nu*L)^r gives a strict floor mu*L when r>log(d)/log((M-mu*L)/(M-nu*L)); equality is rejected
locked_formulas.soft_blocks: for w=m-U, a=(w-g)_+, v=(g-w)_+, B_plus=g*I+T_a-T_v+2*|p_plus><p_plus| and B_minus=g*I+T_a-T_v-2*|p_minus><p_minus|
locked_formulas.soft_trace: for r>=1 on the even high space, trace(D_g(B_plus)^r)<=trace(R_H^r)<=integral v^r*kappa_H*dnu, R_H=P_H*T_v*P_H
locked_formulas.leverage_excess: for tau=(c-nu)*L and E_tau=integral (v-tau)_+*kappa_H*dnu, the even soft block is >mu*L if E_tau<(nu-mu)*L
locked_formulas.scalar_excess: for r>1, tau>0, and x>=0, (x-tau)_+<=((r-1)^(r-1)/(r^r*tau^(r-1)))*x^r; equality occurs at x=r*tau/(r-1)
locked_formulas.odd_reserve: if 0<delta<=1, rho1+a*L*mu0<=(1-delta)*a*c*L^2/2, and M>=M0, then M-2*|p><p|>=delta*a*L*I; load one is not strict
locked_formulas.odd_one_direction_schur: with e=p/sqrt(mu0), alpha=<e,Me>, b=P_(e_perp)Me, C=P_(e_perp)MP_(e_perp), positivity is equivalent to C>0 and alpha-2*mu0-<b,C^(-1)b>>0
locked_formulas.principal_tail: for F=E intersect 1^perp and s=||P_E*1||^2, ||(I-P_F)z||^2<=(2*lambda/s)*||(I-P_E)z||^2 for z perpendicular to 1
locked_formulas.augmented_determinants: D_plus=I0^(-1)*det([integral; physical rows]) and D_minus=(-1)^N*I2^(-1)*det([integral; physical rows]) after the exact zero-integral column operations
